rules.full_mean: mean point Euclidean error within each original anchor-instance, then equal anchor-instance mean
rules.conditional_mean: mean subset-point error within each nonempty anchor-instance subset, then equal nonempty anchor-instance mean
rules.contribution: subset point-error sum / original object point count, then mean over ALL original anchor-instances
rules.zero_subset_source: frozen CRN-CV v2 coverage_object_records: zero subset mean times subset count; no raw point-norm recomputation
